svg.title: Distributed Message Queue — End-to-End Architecture
svg.desc: Architecture of a high-throughput distributed message queue showing smart batching producers, 3-AZ ISR broker replication, KRaft Raft metadata quorum, segmented commit log with sparse offset index and sendfile zero-copy I/O, pull consumer groups, KIP-932 share groups, and hierarchical timing wheels.
svg.text: Distributed Message Queue — End-to-End Architecture (1M msg/s, RF=3, 14-Day Retention)
Smart Batching Producers · 3-AZ ISR + KIP-101 Epochs · Segmented Log + sendfile() Zero-Copy · KRaft Quorum & KIP-848/932 Consumers
2. Partition Brokers (3 AZs · RF=3 · ISR Replication)
Cloud Economics (1M msg/s · 1 KB · RF=3 · 14 Days)
Storage: 86.4 TB/d -> 3.63 PB RF=3 (1.21 PB @ 3x zstd); KIP-405 S3.
Cross-AZ: $103.7k/mo raw ($34.6k/mo zstd) -> diskless S3 brokers.
4. On-Disk Segmented Commit Log, Sparse Index & Linux Zero-Copy I/O
Disk -> Kernel Page Cache -> NIC DMA
Immutable RecordBatch Wire / Disk Layout (Shared by Producer, Broker, Consumer — Zero Re-Serialization)
Avoids topic explosion & wasted consumer egress
Stage 1: Broker matches 64-bit tag hash in index
Stage 2: Consumer verifies exact tag string
Coarse wheel (min/hr) cascades into fine wheel (s)
Backed by durable delay topics for crash recovery
Moves due messages into target topic on tick
